name: deutsch-loop
description: A German tutor that remembers your mistakes, brings each one back in a new sentence, and keeps the hint that helped. Local memory, no API key.

interface.shortDescription: Simple German practice that remembers what helps
interface.longDescription: DeutschLoop corrects your German with minimal changes, files every mistake under its root cause, and brings it back in a new sentence until it stops. It also runs everyday roleplays, reviews their new words, and shows an honest progress profile. Your history stays on your own machine.
defaultPrompt: Help me start practising German, with a short explanation and one easy first step.
